{"parentUuid":"03c68e1e-cc75-451f-bc3c-74d811fe916e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaVSyREgkQnMSX96nMoX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The review is done. I reproduced three Spec findings. The nested-table one breaks the saved table:\n\n```\n<table><tr><td>a</td><td><table>…x y / 1 2…</table></td></tr>…</table>\n→ | a | | x | y | | --: | --: | | 1 | 2 | |\n  | :-- | :-- |\n```\n\nA Markdown table's header row has to have as many cells as its alignment row. This header has more, so the whole table would render as a paragraph of pipe characters. `<b>1</b>,234` and `$ 1,234` also left-align a numeric column, as the Spec reviewer said.\n\n## Standards\n\n**No hard violations.** No site links or assets with `/…` paths, no new forms, no new dependency, `site/` untouched. The standard form is still decided only in `app/markdown_form.py` (ADR-005). The CSS class has the `admin-` prefix.\n\nJudgement calls:\n1. **Misleading name:** `_MOST_COLUMNS = 1000` limits `rowspan` as well. Suggested name: `_MOST_SPANNED`.\n2. **Misleading name:** `cleanPasted` now returns a `<div>` element under the key `html`, not HTML text.\n3. **Shadowing:** in `regularTables`, the arrow parameter `rows` hides the outer `rows` array.\n4. **Duplicated code:** the \"empty paragraph\" test appears in both `placeBlocks` and `removeTable`. Extract `isEmptyParagraph`.\n5. **Dead code:** `\"style\"` is still allowed on posted `th`/`td` in `app/editor.py`, but nothing reads it any more. I checked: nothing in `markdown_form.py` does.\n6. **Mild:** \"rows of cell contents\" is an unnamed shape passed between functions. The comment on `buildTable` is enough at this size.\n\nHaving the merged-cell logic in both Python and JS is justified: pasting has no server round trip, and the server mustn't trust the client's layout. But the two already disagree: JS allows `rowSpan` up to 65534, while the server caps it at 1000.\n\n## Spec\n\n**(a) Missing or partial**\n- The browser check is still outstanding. That's your hand step.\n- The client-side paste code (`cleanPasted`, `regularTables`, TSV parsing) has no automated test; only the browser check covers it.\n- Automatic alignment happens only when the Editor saves. A table written through the Markdown fallback keeps the alignment it was stored with. This follows from your save-time decision; it should be said in the closing comment.\n\n**(b) Scope creep:** nothing of substance. A paste inside a cell becomes text only, and Insert table is disabled inside a table; both keep a table row to one line. `N/A` counts as missing as well as `n/a`.\n\n**(c) Looks implemented, but wrong**\n1. **A nested table breaks the table.** Reproduced above. Excel and Sheets don't produce one, but a paste from a web page can.\n2. **Formatting inside a number splits it.** `<b>1</b>,234` is read as `1 ,234`, and `<a>12</a>%` as `12 %`, so the column left-aligns. Reproduced.\n3. **Excel's Accounting format isn't a number.** `$ 1,234`, `$ (3.2)`, `$ -` and `$(1,000)` all fail. Reproduced. Arguably this is within the spec's wording, but Accounting format is common in IR sheets.\n4. **Row above on the header row** turns the old header into a body row, and its text then left-aligns that column. That's consistent with \"the first row is always the header\", but a writer may not expect it.\n\n**Summary:** Standards has 6 findings, all judgement calls; the worst is the dead `style` allowance. Spec has 4 in section (c) plus the outstanding browser check; the worst is the nested table breaking the saved Markdown."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1191,"cache_read_input_tokens":199585,"output_tokens":1926,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":158},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1191},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1926,"cache_read_input_tokens":199585,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1191,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1191,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"f0bb56fd-affb-4b9b-81d5-2c0bfed0a53c","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CfaVSxwThomfDNGF3ebXP","type":"assistant","uuid":"c12790cf-e23b-41ef-915f-8b3935cc7748","timestamp":"2026-09-30T23:28:18.877Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"6f9c9dd4-e223-4ae0-b659-f5d52d1a7913","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

Test: `test_a_table_inside_a_cell_is_written_as_its_text` |\n| **Formatting inside a number split it**: `<b>1</b>,234` was read as `1 ,234`, so its column left-aligned | **Fixed** (8fca16f): a cell's text runs inline parts together. Test: `test_a_number_with_formatting_inside_it_is_still_a_number` (4 cases) |\n| Excel's Accounting format (`$ 1,234`, `$ (3.2)`, `$(1,000)`, `$ -`) isn't counted as numeric | **Kept**: outside the spec's rules as written (a leading `$`, and `(3.2)`). {"parentUuid":"1dc35192-a083-4682-b694-1e359191d0d5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaWCbfm4PtjES4hWSYWt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I ran the review, fixed the two findings you picked, and posted everything on the ticket. #18 is still open.\n\n**Fixed, test-first** (`8fca16f`; full suite passes, 674 tests):\n- **Table inside a cell:** a paste from a web page can nest one, and it used to break the whole Markdown table. It's now saved as the inner table's text.\n- **Numbers with formatting:** a number with formatting inside it, like `<b>1</b>,234` or `<a>12</a>%`, now counts as a number, so its column right-aligns.\n\nThe review comment on #18 lists every finding and how it was resolved: https://github.com/DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/18#issuecomment-5921662569\n\nEverything else is marked \"Kept\" there, with a reason for each:\n- **Standards:** all six were judgement calls, not rule breaks. They include naming, a small duplication, and the `style` allowance nothing reads any more.\n- **Spec:** Excel's Accounting format isn't counted as a number; it would need its own amendment if you want it.
